row.name: classes_homeroom_idx
row.where: status = 'active' and homeroom_class_id is not null

row.name: classes_shape_check
row.value: (class_type = 'homeroom' and homeroom_class_id is null and subject_descriptor_id is null) or (class_type = 'scheduled' and course_id is not null and subject_descriptor_id is not null)

row.name: enrollments_position_check
row.value: classroom_position_descriptor_id is null or role in ('teacher', 'aide')

row.name: enrollments_valid_during_check
row.value: not isempty("valid_during") and not lower_inf("valid_during") and not upper_inf("valid_during") and lower_inc("valid_during") and not upper_inc("valid_during")
